findings: Centering slice calculation: Simple findIndex selected the peripheral entry slice of the tooth region. Filtering all matching indices and selecting the one closest to the arch anchor coordinate (or the median index) centers the crosshair directly over the pulp chamber and root apex.

Clutter mandate invariant: Clinicians require an unobstructed panoramic view. Placing the ribbon in a dedicated 28px strip docked above the panoramic viewport, turned off by default, and accessible via the compact [FDI] toolbar button maintains clinical purity.

Z-Index collision avoidance: The clinical HUD badge sits at top-1.5 left-1.5 with z-20. Positioning the mode switcher at top-9 left-2 with z-30 eliminates pointer event interception and gives clean visual separation.
Volume loading efficiency: 312 slices (600x600, 112,320,000 voxels) are assembled and loaded in ~1.6s in browser memory, with seamless WebGL2 3D texture integration.
